Name: Raised Garden Beds
Author: bblueberry
Description:
[size=3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/hhmsueA.png[/img]

Fancy making the most of the unplantable space on your farm? Spotted the perfect site for a herb garden?
Maybe you're just in it for the aesthetic! Build a garden bed anywhere you like on the farm, and grow your stuff in style.
Build them in unique shapes, or fill in a big grassy patch with crops. Remember, though: you can't walk over them!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Gbi0Ju7.png[/img]﻿ Garden beds work much the same as Evelyn's garden pots: unlockable, un-sprinkler-able, and all craftable!
﻿ ﻿ When you've made friends with Robin, she'll visit after early Summer and give you the basic recipes.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/bw0LdyU.png[/img]﻿ Build big raised gardens by placing them together! Work them into whatever shape you like to match your theme.
﻿ ﻿ Build in lines, blocks, and around corners; build on grass, dirt, and sand! Style your farm like you've always wanted.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/zo2w0r8.png[/img]﻿ Grow in-season crops outdoors, and any-season crops in the greenhouse.
﻿ ﻿ Garden beds break down at the end-of-season if they've grown old, but multi-season crops survive if they're fixed!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Gbi0Ju7.png[/img]﻿ There's a few varieties to start off, each using different resources to craft, and with different lifespans.
﻿ ﻿ You'll find new themes appear as you reach different milestones while playing ...



[img]https://i.imgur.com/gdLDpSx.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/SgN73uL.png[/img]﻿ [color=#F8C633][size=4][b]Make sure everyone has the mod installed before joining in multiplayer![/b][/size][/color]
﻿Bad things will happen if they don't, all farmhands should have the same custom objects as the host!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/Af4YbCX.png[/img]

Translations for Raised Garden Beds and all of its content packs are handled in a unique way: translators can upload their own translation packs as content packs for Content Patcher, and include translations for any-and-all RGB content packs in one pack!
For info on making translation packs, [url=https://github.com/b-b-blueberry/RaisedGardenBeds/blob/b-b-blueberry-readme-authors/author-guide.md#adding-translations]click here to read the documentation![/url]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/d1sSW6N.png[/img]﻿ [color=#F8C633][size=4][b]Garden beds break with age[/b][/size][/color]
— Garden beds will break down over time, similar to fences.
You'll get a small refund on crafting ingredients when tearing down broken garden beds.
Replace them by dropping in another of the same type. More expensive varieties will last for more seasons!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/kyDOj12.png[/img]﻿ [size=4] [color=#F8C633][b]Recipes always available[/b][/color][/size]
— Don't fancy unlocking them over time? Get 'em all straight away!
It might take away the magical wonder of discovery, but the choice is yours!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/pDvC1Qz.png[/img]﻿ [color=#F8C633][size=4][b]Sprinklers enabled[/b][/size][/color]
— Normally sprinklers can't be used for garden pots and raised beds.
Sprinklers in or beside garden beds will water them for you if checked!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/d1sSW6N.png[/img]﻿ [color=#F8C633][size=4][b]Usable in greenhouse[/b][/size][/color]
— Set up plantable garden beds around the tiled floors of your greenhouse.
Plants in them will grow just the same as any other!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/kyDOj12.png[/img]﻿ ﻿[color=#F8C633][size=4][b]Usable in farmhouse[/b][/size][/color]
— Build a garden inside your own home!
Sprinklers placed on garden beds indoors will work just as if outside.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/pDvC1Qz.png[/img]﻿ [color=#F8C633][size=4][b]Usable in farm buildings[/b][/size][/color]
— Same as the last, you can build garden beds inside your sheds,
barns, as well as any other buildings on the farm!
